symptom:
A deposit ledger (server/main.go) appends each ADD n to data/ledger.log and answers OK; TOTAL returns the sum of the entries, rebuilt from the log on start. The client makes 150 deposits, remembers which were acknowledged and which were not, and at the end checks that the ledger total is at least the sum of the acknowledged deposits and at most the sum of everything it ever sent.

Observed on seed 1: the server was crashed during a disk operation at 598ms and at 1.7s. The final check failed: ledger total covers every acknowledged deposit: {"left":5453,"right":5506,"unacked":1831}. The total was 53 below the acknowledged sum, and the server logged no error.

Expected: the total must never be below the sum of acknowledged deposits, whatever crashes happen.
